'''IndusInd Bank Limited''' is an Indian banking and [[financial services]] company based in [[Mumbai]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Annual Report 2018-19 |url=https://www.indusind.bank.in/content/dam/indusind-corporate/investor-resource/latest-annual-report/AnnualReport201819.pdf |access-date=16 February 2020 |work=www.indusind.bank.in}}</ref> It was established in April 1994 and [[Corporate promoter|promoted]] by the [[Hinduja Group]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kochuveedan |first=Benn |date=2024-04-25 |title=IndusInd Bank net profit up 15% to Rs 2,349 crore in Q4 |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2024/Apr/25/indusind-bank-net-profit-up-15-to-rs-2349-crore-in-q4 |access-date=2025-03-21 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Deva |first=Pranati |title=ICICI Direct picks IndusInd Bank as a 'High Conviction Idea' for December; here's why |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/icici-direct-picks-indusind-bank-as-a-high-conviction-idea-for-december-heres-why-11702450569967.html |website=Mint}}</ref>

== History ==
IndusInd Bank was among nine 'new-generation'{{ref label|New-generation|a}} banks that obtained a banking license in 1994; it was started by [[S. P. Hinduja]] along with hundreds of [[Non-Resident Indians|NRI]] and other shareholders.<ref>{{cite news |title=IndusInd Bank debuts on Nifty; shares soar 3% |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/indusind-bank-debuts-on-nifty-shares-soar-3/articleshow/19327034.cms |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=1 April 2013}}</ref> Named after the [[Indus Valley Civilisation]], the bank began its operations on 17 April 1994, after being inaugurated by the then [[Ministry of Finance (India)|Union Finance Minister]] [[Manmohan Singh]].<ref>{{cite web |title=IndusInd Bank Annual Report 2003-2004 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/HIS_ANN_RPT/HISTANNR/2004/INDUSIND_BANK_LTD-532187-MARCH-2004.PDF |publisher=BSE |access-date=1 March 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=IndusInd Bank Ltd. - History |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/indusind-bank-5531/information/company-history |work=Business Standard India}}</ref>  It launched its [[initial public offering]] in 1997.<ref>{{cite news |title=Indusind Bank Net Up 24 Per Cent At Rs 91 Cr |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/indusind-bank-net-up-24-per-cent-at-rs-91-cr-198051501054_1.html |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=Business Standard}}</ref>

In 2004, IndusInd Bank completed its merger with Ashok Leyland Finance, a [[vehicle financing]] company which was also part of the [[Hinduja Group]].<ref>{{cite news |title=RBI clears IndusInd merger with Ashok Leyland Fin |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rbi-clears-indusind-merger-with-ashok-leyland-fin/articleshow/742796.cms |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=16 June 2004}}</ref>

IndusInd Bank listed on the [[Luxembourg Stock Exchange]] in 2007 by issuing [[global depository receipts]] (GDRs) worth {{INRconvert|147|c|mode=historical|year=2007}}. In 2008, it issued fresh GDRs worth {{INRconvert|222|c|mode=historical|year=2008}}.<ref>{{cite news |title=IndusInd taps overseas market to raise Rs 222 cr |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indusind-taps-overseas-market-to-raise-rs-222-cr/articleshow/3161733.cms |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=25 June 2008}}</ref>

In 2011, IndusInd Bank acquired [[Deutsche Bank]] India's loss-making credit cards division.<ref>{{cite news |title=Deutsche sells credit card biz to IndusInd |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/news-archive/web/deutsche-sells-credit-card-biz-to-indusind/ |access-date=1 March 2025 |work=The Indian Express |date=11 April 2011 |language=en}}</ref>

In October 2017, IndusInd Bank announced its acquisition of [[Bharat Financial Inclusion Limited]] (BFIL) for {{INRconvert|15000|c|mode=historical|year=2017}}.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Hetavkar |first1=Nikhat |title=IndusInd acquires Bharat Financial in Rs 15,000-cr deal |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/indusind-bank-approves-deal-to-buy-bharat-financial-inclusion-117101400389_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=October 15, 2017}}</ref>  The merger was officially completed in July 2019.<ref>{{cite news |title=IndusInd Bank-Bharat Financial merger to be effective from July 4 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indusind-bank-bharat-financial-merger-to-be-effective-from-july-4/articleshow/69863550.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=June 19, 2019}}</ref>

== Operations ==
As of 2026, the bank has 42 million customers, 3,136 branches, and 2,870 [[Automated teller machine|ATMs]] spread across India, covering 1,62,000 villages, Including foreign presence in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.<ref>https://www.indusind.bank.in/in/en/about-us.html</ref> It is an empaneled banker for [[Multi Commodity Exchange|MCX]]. Its shares have been a part of the [[NIFTY 50]] index since 1 April 2013.<ref>{{cite news |title=IndusInd Bank goes live on direct tax collection system of CBDT |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/finance/indusind-bank-goes-live-on-direct-tax-collection-system-of-cbdt-16244521.htm |publisher=[[CNBC TV18]] |date=March 23, 2023}}</ref>

== Controversies ==

=== Derivative accounting discrepancies ===
Between 2023 and 2025, IndusInd Bank identified accounting irregularities related to its [[Derivatives market|forex derivatives]] transactions, after a September 2023 directive from the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) mandated banks to adopt [[Mark-to-market accounting|mark-to-market]] valuation for derivatives. An initial internal review estimated the potential financial impact at ₹1,572 crore in December 2023, which was revised upward to ₹2,361 crore by May 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sebi bars former IndusInd Bank CEO, four others from market for insider trading |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/sebi-indusind-bank-sumant-kathpalia-insider-trading-11748442555094.html |website=Mint}}</ref>

On 11 March 2025, IndusInd Bank's shares crashed over 27% after it disclosed the discrepancies, with analysts raising questions on the bank's internal controls.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-03-11 |title=IndusInd Bank shares crash 27% to record worst trading day ever. Here's why |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/indusind-bank-shares-crash-20-to-hit-52-week-low-why-is-it-falling-today-2691909-2025-03-11 |access-date=2025-03-11 |website=India Today |language=en}}</ref> IndusInd Bank's Managing Director and CEO, Sumant Kathpalia, resigned in April 2025, taking "moral responsibility" for the discrepancies. His resignation followed that of Deputy CEO Arun Khurana, who stepped down a day earlier.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-01 |title=IndusInd Bank CEO resigns |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry/nbspindusind-bank-ceo-resigns/3826942/ |access-date=2025-05-01 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}}</ref>

Independent audits were conducted by [[PwC]] and [[Grant Thornton]], with Grant Thornton estimating a cumulative impact of approximately ₹1,960 crore. In April 2025, the bank reported a reduction in net worth of ₹1,979 crore, or 2.27%, following revaluation adjustments.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-05-16 |title=IndusInd Bank clarifies on new accounting irregularities, says Rs 674 crore 'incorrectly recorded as interest' |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indusind-bank-clarifies-on-new-accounting-irregularities-says-rs-674-crore-incorrectly-recorded-as-interest/articleshow/121192583.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-06-27 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last1=Mahanta |first1=Vinod |last2=Mehta |first2=Sangita |date=2025-05-15 |title=IndusInd Bank probes yet another accounting issue |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indusind-bank-probes-yet-another-accounting-issue/articleshow/121170868.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-06-27 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-27 |title=NFRA to investigate IndusInd Bank over accounting discrepancies in forex derivative |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-nfra-to-investigate-indusind-bank-over-accounting-discrepancies-forex-derivative-3858967/ |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=The Financial Express |language=en}}</ref>

=== Insider trading investigation ===
After the accounting discrepancies came to light, reports stated that [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] began investigating possible [[insider trading]] by senior officials of the bank.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sebi probes insider trading at IndusInd Bank: Report |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/business/indias-markets-regulator-probes-insider-trading-at-indusind-bank-report-3464876 |access-date=2025-03-27 |website=Deccan Herald |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=Mar 27, 2025 |title=Insider trading glare on senior IndusInd Bank officials. What do rules say? |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/insider-trading-glare-on-senior-indusind-bank-officials-what-do-rules-say-125032700415_1.html }}</ref> In May 2025, SEBI banned Kathpalia and four others from dealing in the share market,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Shaikh |first=Subhana |date=2025-05-28 |title=SEBI Bans IndusInd Bank Ex-CEO Sumant Kathpalia, Four Others From Securities Market |url=https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/sebi-bans-indusind-bank-ex-ceo-sumant-kathpalia-four-others-from-securities-market |access-date=2025-05-29 |website=NDTV Profit |language=en}}</ref> accusing them of selling shares before the bank publicly announced the losses and avoiding about ₹20 crore in losses. SEBI froze their accounts and barred them from trading while the investigation continued.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-28 |title=SEBI bars former IndusInd Bank CEO, top executives from stock market over insider trading charges - BusinessToday |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/sebi-bars-former-indusind-bank-ceo-top-executives-from-stock-market-over-insider-trading-charges-478149-2025-05-28 |access-date=2025-06-27 |website=Business Today |language=en}}</ref>

=== Microfinance Division Fraud ===
In May 2025, IndusInd Bank disclosed a suspected internal fraud in its microfinance division after discovering that ₹172.58 crore had been wrongly recored as fee income across three quarters of FY25. The bank initiated legal and disciplinary actions against the involved employees following an internal investigation.<ref>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indusind-bank-flags-fraud-in-microfinance-business-rs-172-58-cr-income-wrongly-recorded-over-three-quarters-in-fy25/articleshow/121318586.cms?from=mdr</ref>
